input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this time expression is redundant because both parts already refer to a historical time. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住了在：住在，an aspect marker cannot be placed between the verb and the location marker; use the location structure without 了 here. [teacher rule: le_placement]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孟子搬家，this means that the mother takes Mengzi with her when moving; 跟 is not the appropriate verb for this relationship. [vocab list]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 搬了到：搬到了，put 了 after the resultative/location complement, not between the verb and 到. [teacher rule: le_placement]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，use 另一个 for one different city; 别的 is used to distinguish other people or things from a previously mentioned one. [teacher rule: bieren]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：一个叫孟子的小男孩和他的母亲，first mention should introduce Mengzi clearly as a character rather than using only his name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子：他，Mengzi was mentioned in the immediately preceding sentence, so a pronoun is more natural for a close re-occurrence. [rule: none]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 那个城市：城里，this is the first mention of a city, so 那个 has no earlier city to refer back to. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
9. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，孟母 is the clear subject in the same sentence, so use a pronoun for the close re-occurrence. [rule: none]
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，daily actions are routines, so they take the zero aspect particle rather than completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代 and 的时候 are redundant time expressions here, and 在古代 is correct.
住了在 has incorrect 了 placement, and the displayed correction 住在 is still cut off before its location.
跟孩子搬家 is acceptable Chinese for moving together with one's child, even though 带着孟子搬家 is also grammatical.
了 must follow 到 in 搬到了 rather than occur between 搬 and 到.
别一个城市 is not the appropriate expression for another city; 另一个城市 is correct.
At first mention, the character should be introduced rather than appearing only as the unexplained name 孟子.
孩子 is vague here, while 他 clearly refers back to the just-mentioned 孟子.
那个城市 can acceptably introduce the story's city deictically, so it is not necessarily an unclear reference.
孟母 has just occurred as the subject, so repeating the name in the same sentence should be avoided in favor of 她.
每天 marks a habitual routine, so the final completed-action 了 should be omitted.
